name: live-v7
note: Four essential worker assignments are retained. Fixed arms first bound worker inputs plus output caps to the baseline worker allowance. After workers finish, unused allowance can fund the root: actual worker tokens plus root input and output allowance may not exceed the corresponding baseline's worker allowance plus baseline root input and root output cap. A root that cannot fit is explicitly scored as resource displacement, without truncating input or fabricating a call. This bounded token allowance is not equal FLOPs or elapsed compute.
